cameraHelp.check: Check whether your camera is already listed there with this RAW mode (for example lossless, compressed or a smaller RAW size). If it is, nothing more is needed.
cameraHelp.copy: Copy the file straight from the memory card, unchanged: not converted to DNG and not passed through another program.
cameraHelp.nothingSent: Rawtonic sends nothing to raw.pixls.us: these buttons only open its pages in your browser.
cameraHelp.preview: Rawtonic can't develop the RAW data of “{{name}}” yet, so it shows the preview the camera stored in the file. That preview can't be exported.

cameraHelp.report: Report a problem with this file…
cameraHelp.reportInstead: Rather not share it publicly? Send a problem report to Rawtonic's makers instead; it is filed privately, and you can attach the file to it.
cameraHelp.shot: If not, take one new photo for it: a well-lit, detailed daylight scene at a low ISO, in focus and well exposed, with the lens on, in landscape orientation. No people, no colour charts and no series with different settings.
cameraHelp.title: Help support this camera
cameraHelp.unreadable: Rawtonic can't open “{{name}}”. If the file came straight from the camera, its camera or RAW mode is probably not supported yet.
cameraHelp.upload: Upload it on raw.pixls.us in your browser. Samples there are public (CC0, public domain), and the file keeps its metadata: the date, the camera's serial number and the GPS position if it was recorded.
cameraHelp.why: Rawtonic reads RAW files with an open-source decoder. Such decoders learn new cameras from sample files shared on raw.pixls.us, a public collection for open-source photo software. You can help by adding a sample there:

crash.always: Always included: Rawtonic's version, your operating system and graphics card, and the date.
crash.backtrace: Backtrace (the functions that were running, with source file names)
crash.intro: Rawtonic quit unexpectedly on {{date}}. This is where it stopped:
crash.messageLabel: Error message (you can correct it before it is sent)
crash.question: Rawtonic quit unexpectedly last time. Send a report?
crash.questionDetail: Rawtonic recorded the crash of {{date}} on this computer. You see everything that would be sent before anything is sent.
crash.setting: Offer to send a crash report after Rawtonic quit unexpectedly
crash.title: Crash report

report.githubPublic: “Open on GitHub” fills in a public issue (text only, no screenshot) that you can still edit there before you submit it; it needs a GitHub account.
report.githubReview: Your browser will open GitHub's public issue form with exactly this title and text in its link, so GitHub receives them when the page loads. Nothing is filed until you submit it there with your GitHub account.
report.noRelay: This build of Rawtonic cannot send reports itself. Copy the report and send it to hello@rawtonic.cc, or open it on GitHub.
report.pendingCrash: Rawtonic quit unexpectedly on {{date}} and that crash report was not sent.
report.photo: Camera and file type of the open photo
report.photoFile: Attach the photo file itself ({{type}}, for problems with how this photo looks)
report.photoFileWarning: The file is sent exactly as it is. It keeps its metadata — the date, the camera's serial number and the GPS position if one was recorded — and it may show people. It is kept privately, only to find the problem, and deleted with the report (by its id, or after 90 days).
report.prepareFailed: The report could not be prepared. It may be too long.
report.screenshot: Screenshot of the window (as it was when you opened this)
report.textLabel: What happened? What did you expect?
report.textPlaceholder: For example: the export stops at the third photo with an error.
report.title: Report a problem

review.deleteFailed: Could not delete it now. Try again later, or write to {{email}} with the id.
review.deleteHint: Or write to {{email}} with this id and the report is deleted.

errors.network: Could not reach Rawtonic's relay. Check the connection and try again.
errors.notConfigured: This build of Rawtonic cannot send reports.
errors.rateLimited: Too many reports right now. Try again later.
errors.refused: The relay did not confirm this report. Try again later.
errors.unapproved: The report changed after it was shown, so it was not sent. Close this and try again.

review.idHint: Keep this id: with it you can have what you sent deleted at any time.
review.intro: This is exactly what Rawtonic will send to its relay, which files it privately for Rawtonic's makers. Rawtonic has tried to remove paths, your user name and serial numbers — check the text below, it may still contain something you do not want to send. Nothing is sent until you click Send.
review.notUploaded: Sent, but the upload of an attached file could not be confirmed. If it arrived, it is deleted with the report.

stats.current: This week so far (sent after the week ends):
stats.description: Off unless you switch it on. Once a week Rawtonic sends which camera models you opened, which tools you used (yes or no — no counts, values or times), its version, your operating system and the maker of your graphics card. No id, no photos, no file names; Rawtonic's relay keeps only counters, not the sends or your IP address. Switching it off deletes what was kept, and nothing more is sent.
stats.due: Finished week, sent at the next start:
stats.nothingYet: Nothing is kept for this week yet.
stats.off: Statistics are off: nothing is kept or sent.
stats.offNotSaved: Switching off could not be saved completely. Statistics are off until Rawtonic quits, but could be on again at the next start. Try again.
stats.onNotSaved: Your choice could not be saved, so statistics stay off. Try again.
stats.setting: Send anonymous usage statistics once a week

offline.standardTitle: The RAW file cannot be read. You see and edit its Standard preview; zooming in enlarges it, and export needs the RAW file. settings.standardLimitDesc: Per previews folder (a project, or photographs outside projects). Beyond it, the Standard previews used longest ago are discarded and made again when their photograph is opened. Previews of offline photographs are kept.

how.autofocus: Focuses once. Skip it with a manual-focus lens or MF set on the camera.

how.release: Checks that each photo was freed on the camera only after it was verified in the library (cameras with a transfer queue).
how.replug: Run, pull the USB cable, then plug it back in. Rawtonic should connect again by itself.
how.setSetting: Changes one setting (such as ISO) to the next value, reads it back and sets it back.
how.shots: Fires the chosen number of shots, each once the one before is in.

test.intro: Run each step with your camera; Rawtonic measures it. Open a photo in Develop first: new photos show there, which times the photo on screen. Nothing is sent unless you choose to: at the end you can send the report below, copy it or open it on GitHub.
test.plugBack: Plug the cable back in (switch the camera on again if it went off).
test.pressShutter: Press the shutter button on the camera now.
test.pullCable: Pull the USB cable out now.
test.reportHint: Camera model and firmware, system, app version, camera driver and the step results only: no serial number, file names, folders, user name or photos.
test.sendIntro: The report below holds only the camera model and firmware, your system, the Rawtonic version, the camera driver and each step's result. Sent, it goes to Rawtonic's relay, which files it privately for Rawtonic's makers to keep the camera list right.

general.autoAdvanceDesc: A rating, pick, reject or unflag key moves to the next photograph when one photo is selected. Toggle with Caps Lock or the Photo menu.
general.builtinPresetsDesc: Show Rawtonic's own styles and presets in Styles & presets and in the tools' preset menus.
general.createXmpDesc: Automatically create a new XMP sidecar file if one does not exist for an image.
general.developToolsDesc: The side of the photo the Develop tools are on. With the tools on the right, the left panel shows the Navigator, Folders and Albums to switch photos.
general.enableAutoAdvance: Move to the next photograph after rating or flagging
general.nativeTitlebarDesc: Use your system's default window titlebar instead of the app's own one.
general.proofMarginDesc: Margin around the fitted photograph when the proof margin is on (Alt+X), as a share of the viewer's shorter side.
general.title: General Settings
general.uiScaleDesc: Enlarges the tool panels and the viewer's bars for long sessions. The photo area keeps its own zoom.
general.viewerBackgroundDesc: Colour around the photograph in Develop. Also on a right-click beside the photograph. Medium is a neutral mid grey for judging tones.
general.xmpSyncDesc: Sync ratings, color labels and tags to standard XMP sidecar files for compatibility with other photo editors.

actions.paste_from_previous: Paste settings from the previous photo
actions.sync_settings: Sync settings to the selected photos
actions.toggle_all_panels: Hide or show all panels and bars
actions.toggle_layer_solo: Show only the selected layer or mask
actions.toggle_metadata: Metadata tool (Library) or photograph info (Develop, full screen)
actions.toggle_multi_view: Multi view: selected photographs side by side
actions.toggle_side_panels: Hide or show the side panels

lenses.description: Create a list of your frequently used lenses to quickly access them in the Lens Correction panel.
lenses.title: My Lenses

processing.aiGpuDesc: Runs AI masks, tags, object removal and AI Denoise on the graphics card when it can (WebGPU; CUDA when installed), otherwise on the processor. Turn off if an AI tool misbehaves.
processing.alwaysDecodeRawDesc: Force full RAW decoding for thumbnails instead of using embedded JPEG previews. Enable this if your thumbnails look different in color or contrast compared to the opened image.
processing.backendDesc: Select the graphics API. 'Auto' is recommended. May fix crashes on some systems.
processing.dynamicDesc: The editor renders the preview to match your display's actual pixel density. This ensures that every detail is represented with 1:1 pixel accuracy, providing maximum clarity when zooming and checking focus.
processing.highDpiDesc: Render previews at your screen's native {{dpr}}x physical pixel resolution. Produces the sharpest possible preview but uses significantly more memory.
processing.highDpiDescStandard: This setting only affects high-DPI displays. Your current display is standard resolution.
processing.linuxCompatDesc: Force software compositing to work around GPU driver crashes. Nvidia GPUs already get a lighter, automatic workaround, so only enable this if you still experience crashes on launch or when opening images.
processing.livePreviewQualityDesc: Controls the resolution and compression of the image while dragging sliders. Lower quality significantly improves responsiveness.
processing.livePreviewsDesc: Update the preview immediately while dragging sliders. Disable this if the interface feels laggy during adjustments.
processing.mediumThumbnailResDesc: Resolution of the preview shown while full images load in the editor.

preprocessing.appleRaw9Desc: Develop RAW files with Apple's Core Image RAW 9 decoder, which demosaics and denoises in one step on the Neural Engine. Requires macOS 27 or later and a supported camera; unsupported files automatically use the built-in decoder. Slower than the default decoder. Thumbnails are not affected.
preprocessing.applyPreprocessingDesc: If enabled, the base color noise reduction and pre-sharpening above will also be applied to standard formats.
preprocessing.colorNrDesc: Applies a cross-bilateral filter early in the pipeline to remove chroma noise. Higher value = Stronger NR.
preprocessing.defaultNonRawTonemapperDesc: The tonemapper to apply to non-RAW images (e.g., JPEG, PNG).
preprocessing.defaultRawTonemapperDesc: The tonemapper to apply to RAW images.
preprocessing.enableAppleRaw9: Use Apple RAW 9 for RAW files
preprocessing.highlightRecoveryDesc: Controls how much detail is recovered from clipped highlights in RAW files. Higher values recover more detail but can introduce purple artefacts.
preprocessing.linearRawDesc: Fixes color casts or pink tint in some DNG files. Controls how already processed LinearRAW data is interpreted.
preprocessing.sharpeningDesc: Applies gentle detail enhancement early in the pipeline. Higher value = More sharpening.
preprocessing.title: Image Preprocessing
preprocessing.tonemapperOverrideDesc: Force a specific tonemapper globally for all images, hiding the tonemapper switch from the adjustments panel.

processing.previewResDesc: Determines the maximum resolution of the preview. Lower values significantly improve performance.
processing.renderScaleDesc: Scales the render resolution relative to your display. Lower values improve performance on high-resolution screens at the cost of some sharpness.
processing.restartRequired: Changes to the processing engine require an application restart to take effect.
processing.smallThumbnailResDesc: Resolution of thumbnails shown in the library grid.
processing.staticDesc: The editor renders the image at a fixed resolution. This mode is the fastest and most consistent, making it ideal for lower-end hardware where smooth performance is prioritized over pixel-perfect zoom.
processing.staticPreviewResDesc: Sets the resolution for static previews like crop mode, lens correction, and perspective tools. Does not affect the main editor preview.
processing.thumbnailResDesc: Determines the resolution of generated library thumbnails. Higher values produce sharper images during loading.
processing.title: Processing Engine
processing.wgpuDescLinux: Bypasses browser encoding for instantly responsive live previews. (Disabled on Linux: Tauri uses GTK for webviews, which conflicts with WGPU on the same X11 surface and causes flickering.)
processing.wgpuDescRecommended: Bypasses browser encoding for instantly responsive live previews. Highly recommended for performance.
processing.workerThreadsDesc: Number of parallel threads used to generate thumbnails. Higher values speed up library loading but use more CPU & RAM.

tagging.aiTaggingDesc: Enables automatic image tagging using an AI (SigLIP 2) model. This will download an additional model and impact performance while browsing folders. Tags are used for searching a folder.
tagging.clearAiTagsDesc: This will remove all AI-generated tags from your .rrdata files in all active root folders. User-added tags will be kept.
tagging.clearAllTagsDesc: This will remove all AI-generated and user-added tags from your .rrdata files in all active root folders. Color labels will be kept.
tagging.customListDesc: If provided, the AI will ONLY use tags from this list, overriding the built-in list. Tagging works only in English.
tagging.maxAiTagsDesc: The maximum number of tags to generate per image.
tagging.noCustomTags: No custom AI tags (Using built-in list)
tagging.shortcutsDesc: A list of tags that will appear as shortcuts in the tagging context menu.
